xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex01062025-05-1313-03-482" status="finalized">       <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> na re dal 'byor yang khyad par can te | so sor thar pa'i rten du rung pa kho na ste | so sor tha pa myed na sems bskyed pa nyid mi 'chags pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro || de ni mi rigs ste | pham pa byung <lb edRef="inst:4477" n="22a6"/> pa 'am 'tshams med pa dang 'brel pa lasogs pa la <note type="gloss">so sor 'thar pa med kyang °</note> yang sems skye ba'i phyir dang | so sor thar pa ni ji srid 'tsho' ba yin pas tshe 'das pa na gtong yang de tsam kyi bya sems mi gtong pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
